title: Markdoc language server configuration
description: Configuration for @markdoc/language-server. An array of site configurations. This plugin uses only the first entry.

id.description: Identifier that uniquely identifies this configuration. Shown as the diagnostic source (markdoc:<id>).

path.description: Directory that contains the Markdoc files, relative to the project root. Defaults to the project root.

root.description: Ignored: this plugin always replaces it with the project root.

server.description: Custom language server for the Visual Studio Code extension. Ignored by this plugin.

path.description: Path to a custom server module, relative to the project root.

watch.description: Restart the server when the module (true) or the files matching this glob (string) change.

templates.description: Templates for the Visual Studio Code extension's "New file from template" command. Ignored by this plugin.

pattern.description: Glob that matches the template files.

preview.description: Enable the preview of the Visual Studio Code extension. Ignored by this plugin.

watch.description: Declared by the language server but not used. Ignored by this plugin.

schema.description: Location of the Markdoc schema and how to load it.

path.description: Path to the schema module, relative to the project root.

type.description: Module format of the schema: "node" loads it with require (module.exports), "esm" with import. When omitted, it is loaded as "esm".

property.description: Name of the exported property that contains the schema. When omitted, the whole module.exports (node) or the default export (esm) is used.

watch.description: Reload the schema automatically when the file changes.

frontmatter.description: Name of the frontmatter property that holds the route of each document.

markdoc.description: Options passed to the Markdoc tokenizer (markdown-it options).

allowIndentation.description: Allow tags and Markdown blocks to be indented by 4 spaces or more without becoming code blocks.

typographer.description: Enable markdown-it typographic replacements and smart quotes.

validateFunctions.description: Has no effect here: Markdoc reads validateFunctions from validation in the schema (config.validation.validateFunctions).
validateFunctions.deprecationMessage: Has no effect. Set validation.validateFunctions in the Markdoc schema instead.
